description: List the results of survey tests in your workspace, newest first, kept after each test ends however it ended. Each has a runId, configId, configName and profileName (as they were when the test started), scenario, the two numbers, channel, state (live or ended), outcome once it ends (completed: every question asked and answered; partial; ended; no_survey_arrived: the survey never came; stopped; start_failed), endReason, expectedTurns, answersGiven and times. The conversation is left out. Takes optional `limit` (at most 100) and `cursor` (nextCursor from the previous page; absent on the last page). Use when: the user asks how survey tests went or whether a survey arrived. For one test's conversation use getSurveyResult with its runId. Read-only. Needs testing:read.

limit.description: Page size. Values above 100 are treated as 100.

name: listSurveyResults

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page. Absent on the last page.

results.description: Newest first. Transcripts are omitted — fetch one result for its turns.

items.description:
What happened in one survey test, kept after the test itself has
ended. One per test, however it ended — including tests that were
stopped, failed to start, or that no survey ever reached.

`outcome` says what HAPPENED, not whether the survey passed: `completed`
means every expected question was asked and answered, and nothing more.

agentE164.description: The nopaque number the survey was sent to.

capture.description:
Where the copy of the conversation stands. `provisional` may still
grow; `final` will not change; `failed` means it could not be
retrieved, with `error` saying why.

channel.description: Observed when the survey arrived; absent if it never did.

configName.description: The respondent's name when the test started. Not updated by a later rename.

endUserE164.description: The number the survey was expected from.

engagedAt.description: When the first survey message was matched to this test.

expectedTurns.description: The question count in force for the test, if one was set.

expiresAt.description: Epoch SECONDS — the close of the test window.

outcome.description:
Set when the test ends.
- `completed` — every expected question asked and answered.
- `partial` — the survey stopped short of its expected questions.
- `ended` — the survey ran; with no question count set, "finished" cannot be known.
- `no_survey_arrived` — the window closed with no message from your platform.
- `stopped` — the test was stopped before its window closed.
- `start_failed` — the number could not be put into service; nothing was sent.

profileName.description: The persona's name when the test started.

turnsTruncated.description: More than 500 messages were exchanged; only the first 500 are kept.

title: List Survey Test Results
